newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS DAY MIXED ON CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS DAY MIXED ON CURRENCIES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the U.S. dollar and sterling but gained against the mark and the rand in early Wednesday trade, foreign exchange dealers said.
"There were a couple of banks buying (U.S. dollars) this morning -- they probably had a few payments to take care of," one dealer said.
At around 0755 GMT the Zimbabwe dollar was trading a cent weaker on the U.S. unit at 11.1575/1675 compared to late Tuesday's 11.1475/1575.

On the crosses, it dropped to 17.9000/9200 against sterling from 17.8700/8900 but edged up on the mark to 6.5400/5500 from 6.5600/5700. Against the South African rand, it was also quoted firmer at 2.5125/5225 compared to 2.5200/5300 the previous day.
